## One-Sentence Description

OrthoAutomate is a done-for-you AI revenue-recovery service that helps private dental clinics recover $30,000 to $150,000 per year by automating missed-call capture, treatment-plan follow-up, and ad-lead conversion — with a 72-hour setup and no long-term contract.

## The Problem OrthoAutomate Solves

Most private dental clinics doing $800K–$3M per year are silently losing $80K–$150K annually to three leaks:

1. **Missed calls** — 30–40% of inbound calls go unanswered during lunch, after hours, or when the front desk is busy. Each missed new-patient call is worth ~$600–$1,200 in lifetime value.
2. **Slow lead response** — Leads from Google and Facebook ads get a reply in hours or days instead of minutes. Response time over 5 minutes drops booking rate by 80%.
3. **Unaccepted treatment plans** — Tens of thousands of dollars in proposed treatment sit unbooked in Dentrix, Open Dental, Eaglesoft, or Curve because nobody has time to follow up.

## The Three AI Systems OrthoAutomate Installs

### 1. AI Receptionist
A voice and SMS AI that answers 100% of inbound calls 24/7, books appointments directly into the clinic's existing PMS, handles common questions (hours, insurance, services), and instantly escalates emergencies or human-requested calls to the front desk with full context.

### 2. Treatment Plan Follow-Up
Automatically scans the practice management system for unaccepted treatment plans and runs personalized SMS/email re-engagement sequences that convert 8–15% of dormant cases into booked treatment.

### 3. Instant Lead Response
Connects to Google Ads, Facebook/Instagram lead forms, and the website. Replies to every new lead in under 60 seconds with a conversational AI that qualifies and books appointments.

## How OrthoAutomate Compares

**vs. Hiring another front-desk staff member:** A new hire costs $40K–$55K/year + benefits, only works ~40 hours/week, calls in sick, and takes weeks to ramp. OrthoAutomate works 24/7, never misses a call, and costs a fraction of one salary.

**vs. Generic AI chatbots:** OrthoAutomate is built specifically for dental workflows — it understands treatment codes, insurance terminology, dental emergencies, and integrates directly with Dentrix, Open Dental, Eaglesoft, and Curve.

**vs. Generic call-answering services:** Human answering services miss the follow-up and treatment-plan recovery work. OrthoAutomate covers the entire revenue leak, not just calls.
